getting_started.title: 1. Getting Started
getting_started.dros_desc: DROS is a minimalist microkernel semantic runtime designed for Enterprise AI Agents. Its core purpose is to eradicate generative AI's two greatest flaws—Hallucinations and Prompt Injections—via a Physical-layer Vajra Discipline.
getting_started.philosophy_quote: “Constrain probabilistic generation with deterministic structures”—Minimal core, explicit rules, effortless maintenance.
steps: Download the core binaries (Windows / macOS / Linux)
Integrate into your AI Agent via our lightweight Adapters

architecture.title: 2. Core Architecture
architecture.desc: DROS adopts a Microkernel design philosophy. All complex logic is decoupled into external rule files.
components: GuardVM: The runtime interception engine responsible for contract validation and instant circuit-breaking.
Vajra Contract: The authoritative rule definition system, written in YAML + Markdown.
Ephemeral Vajra Discipline: Dynamic synthesis of AGENT.MD + Vajra.md + user input for each task, expiring immediately after.
T-Number Coordinate System: Physical file-based exact traceability mechanism, ensuring every inference step is auditable.
Pure Physical File Topology: Complete abandonment of Vector DBs, eliminating semantic drift and labeling pollution.

writing_rules.title: 3. Rule Drafting Guide (Critical)

agent.name: AGENT.MD
agent.desc: Defines the Agent's role, capability boundaries, permitted operations, and prohibited behaviors.

vajra.name: Vajra.md
vajra.desc: Defines global disciplines, priorities, compliance requirements, security perimeters, and fusion conditions.

domain.name: Domain Rule Files
domain.desc: Enterprise internal FAQs, policies, workflows, and risk controls (can be multiple Markdown files).

practices: Use clear headings and YAML blocks to define rules.
The more precise and structured the rules, the stronger the Vajra protection.
Maintainable by internal domain experts; no senior AI engineers required.
